title: Kalaam : Janab Mujahid Ali Sahab
body:
Ghazi Madad ko aao Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aayi ek qayamat liye haye shaame Ghareebaa'n
Naizo'n ki aniyou'n pa jab chadar hui ayaa'n
Har bibi ke labo'n par thi us waqt yahi sada
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Shimre maloon ka wo jab khayi hai tamaacha
Gohar Sakina(s.a) ke shaqi jab cheen ne laga
Besaaqta tadap kar ye karne lagi fughaa'n
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Qaime jale hain haye sab asbaab lut gaya
Masoom Ali Asghar(a.s) ka jhoola bhi jal gaya
Bistar ko khainchte hi bas Sajjad(a.s) ne kaha
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Oonto'n ki nangi pusht par baithi thi bibiyaa'n
Sab haath to bandhe the, na thi amariyaa'n
Maao'n ki goud se gire bacche to di sada
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Aulaad e Ali(a.s) saamne hai nange sar khadi
Hai bughze Ali(a.s) tumko to badle ki hai ghadi
Aawaaze shaqi sun ke ye Zainab(s.a) ne ye kaha
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Beshak imaam e Asr(a.s) ka hoga zahooor ab
saaraate Hussain(a.s) ho bedaar shaoor Ab
lena hai inteqaam ab khoone Hussain(a.s) ka
<<MINI>>
Jald aao ... Ghazi Madad ko aao
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Janab Mujahid Ali Sahab
